pros: Comprehensive project views and customization for tracking client projects.
Ability to centralize project data and manage workflows effectively.
Good for overseeing multiple parallel tasks and project health at a glance.
cons: Initial setup and learning curve can be complex due to extensive features.
The interface can feel cluttered or overwhelming with default panels and options.
Some difficulty with advanced reporting or specific view layouts like Gantt/Calendar.
